instructions: Frozen before any held-out run (#40). Changing this file, the skill, the runner, or heldout.json after prompts are written makes every existing run directory stale; report refuses to read them.

absolute_gates.preserved: every protected span survives in every with-skill output
absolute_gates.damage: the blind grader finds no damage to good material in any with-skill output
absolute_gates.presentation_noop: Every clean input unchanged after at most one transport final LF and one optional code wrapper; raw exact_noop also reported.

grader: A model from a different family than the one that generated the outputs. It sees only blind/: case, request, input, and outputs labeled A and B, never which arm produced which.
report: Per family, per run, and per case. Never pool families. A paired win over the without-skill arm does not override a failed absolute gate.
